title: What a Godly Man Does While He Waits for a Wife (It's Not Searching)
caption:
You're not stuck in a waiting room. You're in a season with work in it.

Seek God first, fix what a wife would have to live with, and hand the ache back to Him at 10 PM instead of chasing it.

What's the one thing God gave you to build this year?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #singleness #seekGodfirst #discipline
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
